reasoning.Student A: Because the mechanism is strategy-proof, truthful reporting is a dominant strategy: no misrepresentation of my ranking can give me a strictly better outcome regardless of how others rank schools. Although many applicants favor y > x > w > z, and I have high priority at w and y (w:1, y:1) and lower priority at x and z (x:2, z:2), that does not create an incentive to lie. Misranking (for example promoting y or x above my true top choice w) cannot improve my assignment in expectation or in any realized outcome under a strategy-proof mechanism. Therefore I should and will submit my true preference order: w most preferred, then z, then x, then y.
